answer: Put senior grader pool elected by stake weight at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 729 aliases would need 729 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the delta here is verification, the horizon of cost is what stops the farm, and the mirror of the record keeps every claim checkable. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
